_meta.how: Daily Huddle asks about a state law or a federal figure in the site's own data files only where a live check agrees with it. Each entry is the check: what the source says, where, and the day it was read. The feeds compare the site's data to it and ask nothing where the two disagree (scripts/huddle/feeds/state-laws.js and compass-more.js).

np-scope.what: The AANP practice environment of every state, against src/_data/stateData.json policy index 2 (3 full, 2 reduced, 1 restricted).
np-scope.src: AANP, 2026 Nurse Practitioner State Practice Environment
np-scope.quote: Full Practice: State practice and licensure laws permit all NPs to evaluate patients; diagnose, order and interpret diagnostic tests; and initiate and manage treatments, including prescribing medications and controlled substances, under the exclusive licensure authority of the state board of nursing.

fica-2025.what: The employee payroll tax figures in src/assets/data/assignment-compass.json, federal.fica, for the 2025 tax year.
fica-2025.src: IRS, Topic 751, Social Security and Medicare withholding rates
fica-2025.quote: The current tax rate for Social Security is 6.2% for the employer and 6.2% for the employee, or 12.4% total. The current rate for Medicare is 1.45% for the employer and 1.45% for the employee, or 2.9% total. Employers are responsible for withholding the 0.9% Additional Medicare tax on an individual's wages paid in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year, without regard to filing status.
fica-2025.ssBaseSrc: SSA, Specifications for Filing Forms W-2 Electronically, tax year 2025
fica-2025.ssBaseQuote: The Social Security Wage Base for tax year 2025 is $176,100.

gsa-fy2026.what: The standard CONUS per diem in src/assets/data/assignment-compass.json, _meta.conusStandard, for federal fiscal year 2026 (October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2026).
gsa-fy2026.src: GSA, FY 2026 per diem rates notice (Federal Register, August 19, 2025)
gsa-fy2026.quote: The M&IE reimbursement rate tiers for FY 2026 are unchanged at $68-$92, and the standard M&IE rate is unchanged at $68.
